accelerator.name: SOSV HAX / SOSV NY / SOSV SF

summary: SOSV’s former IndieBio locations were renamed SOSV NY and SOSV SF in 2026. HAX remains its hard-tech program. These are separate programs with rolling applications, not a single dated cohort.

sources.title: IndieBio — The Original
sources.supports: Official announcement explains the 2026 rename to SOSV NY and SOSV SF.

sources.title: SOSV Application FAQ
sources.supports: Rolling application review; applicants need at least two team members to enter a program.

sources.title: The HAX Program
sources.supports: Hard-tech support and up to $550K initial funding with a six-month Newark residency.

notes: Do not combine different programs into one invented calendar event. Current HAX FAQ contains older funding figures conflicting with its program page; confirm detailed terms directly.
